desc: Derive and verify the bounded extension-count formula for valid left/right extensions under length limit `k`.
Implement monotonic-stack boundaries for maximum contributions with consistent duplicate-value ownership.
Implement analogous monotonic-stack boundaries for minimum contributions.
Validate against the provided examples and randomized brute-force tests, including ties and negative values.
Ensure `O(n)` time and `O(n)` auxiliary space for `n <= 80000`.
